buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC): 1. This is an Open Tender Enquiry (OTE), Offers of Non-established firms which are technically acceptable s ubject to capacity verification w.r.t to Vendor Qualification Criteria by HVF will only be considered for price bid opening, other offers are summarily rejected. The offer of established/past suppliers of this particular it em and registered with HVF & Offers of established vendors for higher assy. will also be accepted. 2. Offers from traders/stockiest will not be accepted and quotations of debarred/Blacklisted suppliers by H VF will not be considered. 3. It is mandatory to submit Vendor Registration Request form (VRRF) through Centralized Vendor Registra tion Portal (COVRP) ie. , http://vendor.avnl.co.in to assess their Capacity for technical recommendation of o ffers. Firms failing to submit VRRF for the subject item after participation in GeM bid will not be considered for price bid opening. 4. The firm should accept offer validity for 180 days. 5. 3% EMD applicable (except registered with MSME, MSE, DIPP). 6. Warranty period-12 months from the date of receipt and acceptance at HVF. 7. Delivery period-365 Days from the date of placement of supply order. 8. In case of failure in delivering items with in delivery period, Liquidated Damage (L.D) at the rate 0.5% pe r week to Max 10% will be imposed for supplies made after original Delivery date. 9. Delivery terms - Free on Road delivery at HVF. 10. Option clause: NOT APPLICABLE. 11. Distribution of TE Qty will be 60% on L1 Firm and 40% on L2 Firm at L1 Rate. 12. Firm should quote for the subject item strictly to meet the drawing, relevant Specification and Quality Acceptance plan(QAP). 13. The firm has to supply the item along with NABL Certificate, PIR, Warranty/ Guarantee certificate and t est piece/button with each consignment.

14. The Inspection will be done at HVF as per drawing/ Specification and QAP. 15. Final acceptance will be done only on receipt of item at HVF. 16. The firm has to submit the PSD for an amount equal to 3% of the total supply order for value more tha n Rs. 10 Lakhs with validity 14 months beyond Delivery period. 17. For new vendors, after successful placement of supply order in GeM portal, firm has to submit requisite documents for registration & allocation of vendor code by HVF. 18. All other terms and conditions will be as per AVNL procurement manual2024. Note: A duly signed /sealed copy of compliance Statement should be submitted along with BID documents as a proof of acceptance of tender conditions. . 2.
